newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Hapoalim to set up new investment bank.
newsitem.headline: Hapoalim to set up new investment bank.

text.p: Bank Hapoalim, Israel's leading commercial bank, on Monday said it would invest 100 million shekels to establish a new investment banking subsidiary.
In June the central bank granted the Hapoalim group a licence for this purpose, said Dan Yahas, who will head Poalim Capital Markets - Investment Bank Ltd.

The wholly-owned investment bank will control the existing Poalim Capital Markets and Investments Holdings Ltd, whose activities include underwriting, mergers and acquisitions and project financing. "We were active for many years in investment banking but were limited in our ability to invest in companies. With the licence we can invest directly and not just act as brokers," Yahas said.
The new investment bank will begin operating soon, he said.
